newsitem.title: GREECE: Short implied vols point to credible hard drachma.
newsitem.headline: Short implied vols point to credible hard drachma.

text.p: Implied volatilities for ecu/drachma and mark/drachma options showed that Greece's hard drachma policy was credible for periods up to three-months, said Alex MacDonald, vice-president at Credit Suisse First Boston.
"Implied volatilities tells us that hard drachma is credible up to three-months," McDonald told a Euromoney conference titled "Greece: A new role in regional and international markets."
The drachma could slip by as much as 9.0 percent according to implied volatilities from 12-month at-the-money ecu/drachma options, he said.

The lack of market depth in drachma-related forex options, reflected in wider spreads of 2.0 vols, made implied volatilites less reliable than they would have been if the options market was liquid, said McDonald.
The hard drachma policy has been pursued by the Bank of Greece to reduce inflation, standing at 5.4 percent year-on-year in May.
It aims at keeping the drachma broadly stable against major EMS currencies in 1997. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
